description: Mid-height seismic isolation of tall, slender equipment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andrew Whittaker, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). First-of-a-kind earthquake-simulator experiments were conducted at the University at Buffalo to examine mid-height seismic isolation as a design solution for protecting tall, slender equipment. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: equipment isolation; mid-height seismic isolation; safety-class equipment; nuclear power plants; earthquake-simulator experiments. Published 2023-01-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
